content: A couple of days ago I saw a post from Evan Prodromou asking if I had seen a product announcement, and was wondering what I thought of the name. I said it was the first I heard of it. I did a little digging with ChatGPT and found they can do this, it’s not illegal or unethical. But it’s also true that you could invent a new format and call it HTML even if it isn’t what we think of as HTML today and the W3C would have no recourse. It’s not a trademark and is not protected. That is if we can trust ChatGPT's advice on such things.
